question: Why is the great Heart said to be the essence of all manifestation?
premises: All things are established in dependence on that consciousness.
Because of that dependence, they have that as their essence.
This existent world, called the egg of Maya, is rooted in Brahma.
inference: Therefore the great Heart is the true essence underlying all manifested existence.
uncertainties: brahmamūlaṃ may be read cosmologically or as a pointer to a higher conscious ground; the verse does not fully resolve the level.
plain_english: Because everything stands dependent on that, its essence is that great Heart. Thus this existent world, called the egg of Maya, is rooted in Brahma.
